vision.name: Heroic Dashing Punch
vision.text:
(Heroes only. Limit 2 per deck.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Raise your anger 1 level. Your opponent skips his next action this combat. For the remainder of combat, life card damage from attacks is banished.
DAMAGE: 5 stages.
HIT: Your opponent cannot gain anger this combat.
(Banish after use.)
vision.review: never officially released: image is overlaid with 'NEVER OFFICIALLY RELEASED' and most text is hidden. Text shown is copied from the card it reprints (S05 #142); visible fragments match, but exact wording on this printing is unconfirmed
